description: Adapt the file validation example from 'docs/example_validator.py' into 'pipeline/validator.py'. The example is a FastAPI web upload validator, but you need to create a CLI file validator. Implement the FileValidator.validate() method to perform three validation checks from the example: (1) file size checking, (2) MIME type validation using python-magic, and (3) file extension validation. Also implement FileValidator.get_validation_errors() to return accumulated errors from the last validation. Key adaptations needed: Remove all FastAPI dependencies (no @app decorators, no UploadFile, no HTTPException), work with Path objects instead of UploadFile, use 'filepath' parameter name instead of 'upload_file', store validation errors in instance variable like 'self.errors' for get_validation_errors() to return, and match the existing class structure in pipeline/validator.py. The validation logic (size limits, MIME type checking, extension whitelist) should be preserved from the example.
